name: Iizuka Kaoru
source:
The commanding officer of the Dominion 17th team. She is strict, on both others and herself, and puts up a strong front. But inside, she is still the oneesan of [url=/c281]Soushichi[/url] back at the island. Her pistol, Harpuria, is customized for her and requires her Youkai ability to form compressed-air bullets. As such, she is able to control the speed, power and size of her shots.

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/12/12/chronobelt-review/]a review[/url] by Warum]
